stories.title: Launch HN: Maritime (YC F26) – A managed cloud for production AI agents
summary: From personal assistants and coding agents to specialized healthcare agents, and the main pattern we saw was that even after choosing a sandbox provider, you still have to build additional infrastructure just to get things working.
Some agents need access to private networks to interact with customer-specific things on prem, or residential IPs, or the ability to restrict network access completely.3.

We started Maritime together this March because of all the issues we faced with trying to deploy agents to the cloud during our research.We want your feedback.If you're building an agent product, what did you have to build on top of sandboxes to make them work?

stories.title: US senators urge White House AI chief to fix vulnerabilities after mass outages
summary: As Democrats flag AI bank breaches and cyber-attacks in Japan, Jay Clayton says system failures happenUS politics live – latest updatesA bipartisan pair of US senators are calling on Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence and AI czar, to identify and fix vulnerabilities in the US’s infrastructure following nationwide outages at major companies and government agencies.Maria Cantwell, the top Democrat on the Senate commerce, science, and transportation committee, and Mike Rounds, the Republican chair of the Senate subcommittee on cybersecurity, sent a letter to Clayton on Tuesday, outlining concerns sparked by reports of AI accessing major banks, cyber-attacks in Japan and more.
